name: Next.js web app
description: Next.js (App Router, TypeScript, ESLint) with pnpm, Vitest + Testing Library, and a CI workflow running the same checks.
notes: Init flags are written from memory and were not executed when this template was added (2026-11-22). Run a real `F new` once and fix them if create-next-app has changed.

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm lint
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - run: pnpm test
      - run: pnpm build

## Working rules

- One issue, one small PR: at most 300 changed lines, tests included.
- Every source change adds or changes a test.
- No new dependencies without a human. A change to `package.json` or a lockfile always goes to a human for review.
- Stay inside the MVP scope in `PLAN.md`. Its non-goals are out of scope.
